scenario: Let is inlined at compile time per LLET.12.5. Let on the RHS (after ->) computes and the result is used in an emit kwarg. Rule fires with t.v==7; emit Trig2 carries diff=3 (7-4).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    let diff = t.v - 4
    emit Out logical dummy: diff
